Last Thursday, Jack and Lily went to the school lab. Jack borrowed a book about art from the park. Lily is interested in swimming. The cheap tickets were a scam.
The weather was rainy that day. It takes twenty minutes to get to the school lab by bike. Jack hopes to visit Rome one day. Everyone calls him by his nickname.
Life is full of small surprises. Jack thinks art is interesting but a little difficult. The school lab is one of the best places in the city. The song is trending in three countries.
They took many photos at the science museum. Jack bought a hat at the shop yesterday. Jack's favorite animal is the bird.
